name: OpsDeck
description:
Your dev machine at a glance: system metrics, listening ports, SSH sessions and tunnels, and Docker containers in one top-bar menu, with kill, end, start/stop/restart, logs and shell actions.

Copy buttons write to the clipboard (only when clicked).

Optional, off by default: Claude plan usage. When enabled it reads the Claude Code login in ~/.claude/.credentials.json (read-only, never modified) and sends that token only to api.anthropic.com to fetch your usage limits.
